_comment: Maker registry (maker = creator, one concept). Agents reference makers by key via their frontmatter `maker` field. Country and business-model facts live here, not on agent records, so multi-product makers (Microsoft, Google, Alibaba...) are described once and the site can pivot on them. Seed examples below; backfill is a follow-up PR.

_schema.country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, or null if unknown
_schema.makes_models: does this maker also make models? (true/false)
_schema.revenue_model: subset of [tokens, subscriptions]; empty list = neither
